notes: 8 web searches ran, none refused; none returned anything about Rutinel and catastrophic AI risk, superintelligence, a pause, or China. The key evidence is his campaign issues page, which is undated: it was read on 2026-11-14 by downloading the page and the quote was copied from its text, so the date field is the read date, not the date written; it was live during the 2026 campaign, but when the AI section was added is unknown. The reviewer should decide between B and C for the "global catastrophe" sentence. His 24 September 2026 public safety plan press release (https://www.mannyforcolorado.com/press-releases/new-manny-rutinel-releases-plan-to-keep-coloradans-safe) mentions "cyber crimes, including misuse of AI technology" only, which is D. As a Colorado state representative he was a House prime sponsor of the 2024 Colorado AI Act (SB 24-205, on algorithmic discrimination, signed 17 May 2024; campaign press release https://mannyforcolorado.com/news-and-media/colorado-ai-consumer-protection-bill-2024); this is before the 2025 period and about discrimination, so it is not in record. No source found on his role in the 2025 delay or the 2026 repeal and replacement (SB 26-189). As a non-member he could not co-sponsor the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act and did not sign the House letters. Search results were otherwise dominated by unrelated pages (for example a podcast host named Manny Bernabe).
